scope: Aggregate presentation of the completed exploratory fly study. No raw recordings, participant identifiers or trial-level EEG predictions are included.

fly.method: Roundup outgoing weights set to zero; three recurrent gains, five paired input seeds, one second per run. Shared exogenous candidates with state-dependent refractory acceptance. Both candidate coupling and an execution correction were post-failure amendments, not preregistered.
fly.limits: Five input seeds are not animals. One model, neuron intervention, endpoint and input regime at three selected gains. No statistical significance, biological validation, novelty or full source-paper replication claimed. The source paper documents left-right inversion of the dataset and uses corrected biological sides. Genetic-driver coverage and historical cell-ID lineage remain unverified.
